note.label: 1 Kings 17: The Word of the Lord in Elijah's Mouth Is Truth

precepts.why:
“Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble. He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.”

The widow’s son fell sick, “and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.” A man’s life is short and full of trouble, and it can be cut down like a flower. The widow took it that the child was paying for her sins: “art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?”

But how long a man lives is not his own to decide, nor the grieving mother’s. That rests with the Most High, as the verses that follow show.

precepts.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee; thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass. When the appointed day comes a man cannot pass it, but this child's day had not yet come.
precepts.point: All praises that Elijah was there to call upon the Lord, for it was not the young man's time to go. A man's days are determined and appointed, and he cannot pass the bound the Most High has set; because it was not the child's time, the Lord let his soul return.

note.label: 1 Kings 17: The Word of the Lord in Elijah's Mouth Is Truth

precepts.why:
“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”. A man’s days are determined and appointed. When the appointed day comes, a man cannot pass it.

But this child’s day had not yet come. Elijah carried him up into the loft, laid him on his own bed, stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried, “O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again. And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.” Because it was not the child’s time, the Lord let his soul return.

All praises that Elijah was there to call upon the Lord. And the widow said, “Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.”

precepts.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one, which speaks of the animals, while Israel as a planted holy seed can be cleansed.
precepts.point: The northern kingdom was planted a holy and righteous seed, so it can be cleansed again, unlike the unclean animals that were made unclean from the beginning. The Most High promised to save Israel out of all their dwelling places where they had sinned and to cleanse them.

note.label: Acts 10: Cornelius and the Northern Kingdom Grafted In

precepts.why:
“Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.”

That speaks of the animals. The unclean animals were made unclean from the beginning, and no prayer makes them clean. But the northern kingdom was planted a holy and righteous seed, so it can be cleansed again. That is why the Most High can say, “What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common”: he is speaking of Israel, not of swine.

note.label: Living Martyrs

precepts.why: “If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.” Every man has an appointed time.

note.label: Living Martyrs

precepts.why:
“Seeing his days are determined”: every man’s days are determined. “The number of his months are with thee”: the number of all our months are with the Lord. “Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass.” You cannot pass it.

Elisha, with the double portion of the Holy Spirit, couldn’t pass that time. The Lord said you are going to get sick and die; that is the judgment, this is your time, you got to go. And Elisha said okay, Lord. Paul said the same thing, and Peter said the same thing. That is how the righteous perisheth: his appointed time came, and he is taken away from the evil to come.

note.label: The Acts Of The Apostles & Foundation Through Christ

precepts.why:
The bounds of their habitation: how long they’ll be here. “Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”.

God created man, and he is superior to man. He determines the bounds that man cannot pass.

note.label: THE CURTAINS OF CONTROL BEHIND TRUMP’S DESK

precepts.why:
God has set people’s bounds that they cannot go beyond, and Esau knows his boundaries. How could he label a section of history the Middle Ages if he had no idea where the end was? He knows he is on borrowed time, and so he says: I am going to be Satan and the devil, manifest destiny, and don’t you niggers get in my way, because I will kill. I am a sociopath, I have no feelings, I am a demon and meant to be a demon until I can’t be no more. That is his nature; that is why he bit you.

“Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.” Who can make the white man a saint? Who can make Esau righteous? Baptizing him, bringing him into church, saying prayers around him, marrying him: that will not change nothing. What God considered unclean, you cannot clean up. Not one of you can.

“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee”: his days are determined by God, and every second of Esau’s months is with the Most High. That is why they research everything: they want to know how much time they have got. Like the empires: Babylon, then Persia and the Medes, the Greeks and the Romans, and out of Rome came an eighth head, America, at the Renaissance, and it shall go into perdition.

“Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”: God has appointed Esau’s boundaries. The Most High set up the rulership, and Esau did a diligent search to find what God in the Bible has to say about his own rulership. When Alexander saw the priests coming with the Bible, he saw it was him, and he was glad: I am in the prophecy to kill, murder, rob and destroy. And he went wild.

Esau does not want to lose that. And the same spirit the Most High put on him, not to want to give it up, is what will kill him when he fights against the Lord. The great red dragon is these red people that you call white. They are the ones that will fight against Christ and the angels and be destroyed in one hour.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why:
Those that die in the Lord: “Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.” We are going to have trouble on this earth, because everything for us here is a test to bring us to salvation, to the kingdom. “He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down”. “Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one”: if you are wicked as hell, we can’t make you clean.

“Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass”. God has your days and your months numbered; if he says you will live 46 years and 6 months, nobody can change that. So no matter what type of death a brother or sister has, don’t automatically think they were the devil. John the Baptist got beheaded; was he the devil? Their time was up.

points: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass.
